11K likes, 123 comments - aarzoo_khurana on October 29, 2026: "Although wildlife will always be my first love, I have been absolutely loving the Portrait Mode on the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra!

During my recent trip to Singalila National Park to photograph red pandas, I also captured some incredible portraits of people from nearby Nepal. Their expressions, skin textures, hair details, and the glint in their eyes caught my attention, so I quickly pulled out my S26 Ultra and started clicking.

Here are some of my favourites. Which one speaks to you the most? 

#collab #GalaxyS26Ultra #TeamGalaxy #withGalaxy @samsungindia

​".
